original: punānaḥ soma dhārayaityatra ṣoḍaśa sāmāni santi| teṣāṃ prathamamāyāsyaṃ sāma| tasya āyāsyāṅigasaḥ ṛṣiḥ| māṇḍave dvitīyam| tasya maṇḍuḥ ṛṣiḥ| tṛtīyacaturthe āpadāsasomasāmanī| tayorvasiṣṭhasomāvṛṣī| pañcamamāyāsyam| tasya āyāsya ṛṣiḥ| ṣaṣṭhaṃ māṇḍavam| tasya maṇḍuḥ ṛṣiḥ| udvatprājāpatyaṃ saptamam| tasya prajāpatiḥ ṛṣiḥ| aṣṭamamāyāsyam|

analyzed: tasya āyāsyaḥ ṛṣiḥ navamam kaṇvarathaṃtaram tasya kaṇvaḥ ṛṣiḥ tiraścīnam āyāsyam daśamam tasya āyāsyaḥ ṛṣiḥ prajāpateḥ sadoviśīyam ekādaśam tasya prajāpatiḥ ṛṣiḥ dvādaśa trayodaśe jamadagneḥ svavāsinī tayacoḥ jamadagniḥ ṛṣiḥ caturdaśam vaśiṣṭhasya plavaḥ tasya vasiṣṭhaḥ ṛṣiḥ agneḥ rauravam pañcadaśam tasya ruruḥ ṛṣiḥ ṣoḍaśam yaudhājayam

analyzed: pari itas siñcata sutam iti ṛcaḥ uktāḥ saptarṣayaḥ eva iha aṣṭādaśa sāmāmani gītāni santi tatra indraḥ ṛṣiḥ tṛtīya caturthe bhāradvāje tayoḥ bharadvājaḥ ṛṣiḥ pañcama ṣaṣṭhe ābhīśave tayoḥ abhīśuḥ ṛṣiḥ saptama aṣṭame māṇḍave tayoḥ maṇḍuḥ ṛṣiḥ navama daśame aṅgirasām abhivāsa parivāsasī tayoḥ aṅgirasaḥ ṛṣiḥ ekādaśa dvādaśe vaiṇava somakratavīye

original: tayorveṇuḥ somakratuśca ṛṣiḥ| dvādaśaṃ māṇḍavaṃ vā | tasya maṇḍuḥ ṛṣiḥ| trayodaśacaturdaśe prajāpatergūdau| kaśyapasya pratodau vā | tayorgūrdapakṣe prajāpatiḥ ṛṣiḥ| pratodapakṣe kaśyapaḥ ṛṣiḥ| pañcadaśaṣoḍaśe aṅgirasāṃ gauṣṭhapuṃstanīye | tayoraṅgirasaḥ ṛṣiḥ| saptadaśaṃ mahārauravam| tasya ruruḥ (ṛṣiḥ)aṣṭādaśaṃ mahāyaudhājayam|

original: tasya yudhājiddṛṣiḥ||||512|ā soma svānaḥ ityṛcaḥ uktā ṛṣayaḥ | santyatra sāmāni catvāri somasāmāni| aśvarupaḥ prajāpatiḥ somo vā caturṇām ṛṣiḥ||||513||

original: pra samo devavītaye ityṛcaḥ uktā ṛṣayaḥ| sāmāni pañca| ādyamagnestriṇidhanam| tsāyagniḥ ṛṣiḥ|dvitīyamagnervaiśvanarasya sāma| tasyāgnirvaiśvānaraḥ ṛṣiḥ. dvihiṃkāraṃvāmadevyaṃ tṛtīyam| tasya vāmadevaḥ ṛṣiḥ| caturthapañcame aṅgirasāmutsedhaniṣedhau | tayoraṅgilasa ṛṣiḥ||||514||
analyzed: pra samaḥ deva vītaye iti ṛcaḥ uktāḥ ṛṣayaḥ sāmāni pañca ādyam agneḥ triṇidhanam ṛṣiḥ dvitīyam agneḥ vaiśvanarasya sāma tasya agniḥ vaiśvānaraḥ ṛṣiḥ dvi hiṃkāram vāmadevyam tṛtīyam tasya vāmadevaḥ ṛṣiḥ caturtha pañcame aṅgirasām utsedha niṣedhau tayoḥ aṅgilasaḥ ṛṣiḥ

original: soma uṣvāṇaḥ sotṛbhiḥityṛcaḥ uktā ṛṣayaḥ| sāmāni ṣaṭ | teṣāṃ somaḥ ṛṣiḥ| aśvo vā||||515||
analyzed: somaḥ sotṛbhiḥ iti ṛcaḥ uktāḥ ṛṣayaḥ sāmāni ṣaṭ teṣām somaḥ ṛṣiḥ aśvaḥ

original: tavāhaṃ soma rāraṇaityṛcaḥ prāguktā ṛṣayaḥ | sāmāni pañca| tayorādde viṣṇoradhamaṇī dve | vaiṣṇave vā | tayorviṣṇuḥ ṛṣiḥ| āṅgirasāni parāṇi trīṇi| teṣāmaṅgirasaḥ ṛṣayaḥ||||516||
analyzed: tava aham soma rāraṇa iti ṛcaḥ prāc uktāḥ ṛṣayaḥ sāmāni pañca tayoḥ ādde viṣṇoḥ adhamaṇī dve vaiṣṇave vā tayoḥ viṣṇuḥ ṛṣiḥ āṅgirasāni parāṇi trīṇi teṣām aṅgirasaḥ ṛṣayaḥ

original: mṛjyamānaḥ sṛhastyāityṛcaḥ uktā ṛṣayaḥ | aṣṭau sāmāni santi| teṣāmāditaḥ aukṣṇorandhrāṇi trīṇi| teṣāmukṣṇo randhraḥ kāpyaḥ ṛṣiḥ| caturthapañcamaṣaṣṭhānyāgneyāni trīṇi| teṣāmagniḥ ṛṣiḥ| saptamamaukṣaṇorandhram| ukṣṇorandhraḥ kāpyaḥ ṛṣiḥ| aṣṭamaṃ vājijit| tasya prajāpatiḥ ṛṣiḥ||||517||
analyzed: mṛjyamānaḥ sṛhastyā iti ṛcaḥ uktāḥ ṛṣayaḥ aṣṭau sāmāni santi teṣām āditaḥ aukṣṇorandhrāṇi trīṇi teṣām ukṣṇaḥ randhraḥ kāpyaḥ ṛṣiḥ caturtha pañcama ṣaṣṭhāni āgneyāni trīṇi teṣām agniḥ ṛṣiḥ saptamam aukṣaṇorandhram ukṣṇorandhraḥ kāpyaḥ ṛṣiḥ aṣṭamam vājijit tasya prajāpatiḥ ṛṣiḥ

original: punānaḥ soma jāgṛviḥityṛcaḥ uktā ṛṣayaḥ | svaḥ pṛṣṭhamāṅgirasaṃ sāma | tsāyaṅgirā ṛṣiḥ||||519||
analyzed: punānaḥ soma jāgṛviḥ iti ṛcaḥ uktāḥ ṛṣayaḥ svar pṛṣṭham āṅgirasam sāma tsāyaṅgirāḥ ṛṣiḥ

original: indrāya pavate madaḥityṛcaḥ uktā ṛṣayaḥ| trīṇi somasāmāni santi| teṣāṃ somaḥ ṛṣiḥ||||520||
